data.title: Fraudulent Deed Transfer Anomaly — Deed Recording With Document Metadata Anomalies (AI Generation Indicators) on Properties With No Prior Activity
data.description: Detects deed recordings that exhibit document metadata anomalies indicative of AI- generated or forged documents, particularly on properties with no recent prior recording activity. The detection combines document forensic signals (AI tool signatures in PDF metadata, rapid creation timestamps, font inconsistencies) with property-level risk factors (no prior recordings in 5 years, vacant status, unencumbered, non-resident owner). Entrust reports a 40% YoY increase in deepfake-related fraud attempts (2026), with AI-forged deeds, government IDs, and notary stamps as primary vectors in real estate title fraud. Notary commission validation is a critical check -- invalid or expired notary credentials are a high-confidence fraud indicator.

enrichment_required.source: AI document forensics analysis of PDF metadata, font consistency, image artifacts, and creation timestamps
Count of recordings against the property in the prior 5 years from county recorder database
Property data enrichment (county assessor, USPS vacancy data)

queries.cql:
// CQL for Fraudulent Deed Transfer Anomaly — DL-0187
// Detects deed recording with AI generation indicators on inactive properties
DeedRecordings
| recording_type = "deed_transfer" OR recording_type = "quitclaim_deed" OR recording_type = "warranty_deed" OR recording_type = "grant_deed"
| notary_invalid := if(commission_status != "active" OR commission_expiry < now(), 1, 0)
| no_prior_activity := if(prior_recordings_5yr <= 0, 1, 0)
| vacant := if(property_occupancy_status = "vacant", 1, 0)
| unencumbered := if(property_mortgage_balance <= 0 OR property_mortgage_balance = null, 1, 0)
| ai_metadata_flag := if(document_metadata_risk_score >= 40, 1, 0)
| rapid_creation := if(document_creation_to_modification_sec < 60, 1, 0)
| composite_risk_score := (notary_invalid * 40) + (ai_metadata_flag * 30) + (no_prior_activity * 20) + (vacant * 15) + (unencumbered * 10) + (rapid_creation * 15)
| composite_risk_score >= 40
| risk_level := if(composite_risk_score >= 80, "critical", if(composite_risk_score >= 60, "high", "medium"))
| recommendation := if(composite_risk_score >= 60, "HOLD_RECORDING", "MANUAL_REVIEW")
| sort(composite_risk_score, order=desc)

queries.sql:
-- SQL for Fraudulent Deed Transfer Anomaly Detection
-- Detects deed recording with AI generation indicators on properties with no prior activity
SELECT
  r.recording_id,
  r.property_id,
  r.property_address,
  r.recording_type,
  r.recording_date,
  r.grantor_name,
  r.grantee_name,
  r.notary_name,
  r.notary_commission_number,
  n.commission_status,
  n.commission_expiry,
  r.document_metadata_risk_score,
  COALESCE(h.prior_recording_count, 0) AS prior_recordings_5yr,
  p.occupancy_status,
  p.mortgage_balance,
  (CASE WHEN n.commission_status != 'active' OR n.commission_expiry < CURRENT_DATE THEN 40 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN r.document_metadata_risk_score >= 40 THEN 30 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN COALESCE(h.prior_recording_count, 0) = 0 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.occupancy_status = 'vacant' THEN 15 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN p.mortgage_balance <= 0 OR p.mortgage_balance IS NULL THEN 10 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE WHEN r.document_creation_to_modification_sec < 60 THEN 15 ELSE 0 END
  ) AS composite_risk_score
FROM deed_recordings r
LEFT JOIN notary_commission_db n ON r.notary_commission_number = n.commission_number
                                 AND r.notary_state = n.state
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT property_id, COUNT(*) AS prior_recording_count
  FROM deed_recordings
  WHERE recording_date >= DATEADD(YEAR, -5, CURRENT_DATE)
  GROUP BY property_id
) h ON r.property_id = h.property_id
LEFT JOIN properties p ON r.property_id = p.property_id
WHERE r.recording_type IN ('deed_transfer', 'quitclaim_deed',
                            'warranty_deed', 'grant_deed')
  AND r.recording_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, CURRENT_DATE)
HAVING composite_risk_score >= 40
ORDER BY composite_risk_score DESC

references: HousingWire, Deed Fraud on the Rise: AI-Powered Property Theft (2025)
First American, Title Fraud: Emerging Threats and Prevention Strategies
falsepositives: Legitimate property transfers on long-held family properties with no recent activity
Estate transfers after death of long-term owner
Quitclaim deeds between family members for estate planning
Properties in rural areas with infrequent recording activity
Documents scanned or digitized from paper originals (may trigger metadata anomalies)
